$comment: System source of truth. Promotion-only: a component-spec artifact enters here by explicit human approval recorded as an ADR. Entries carry a `level` (ADR-012): 1 = usable in L1 Foundations output, 2 = full library.

coforge.note: L2 rows are a THIN catalogue; the full contract for each is in design-system/components/<Name>.json. Both satisfy design-system/contracts/component.schema.json. L2 is generated by validation/adapters/carbon-react.py — do not hand-edit it. L1 is ours.
coforge.keyed_on: public export symbol, not directory name

components.name: cf-type-scale
components.summary: Heading and body sizes. The only legal type sizes for L1 output.

a11y.note: colour must never be the only carrier of meaning

components.when_to_use: Never set a font-size directly; pick a level.
components.when_not_to_use: Do not invent an intermediate size — if none fits, propose a token, not a one-off.
components.source: CoForge L1 primitive — derived from tokens, not from Carbon components

components.name: cf-colour-roles
components.summary: Semantic colour roles — background, layer, text, border, support.

a11y.note: colour must never be the only carrier of meaning

components.when_to_use: Use the role, never the palette entry — roles re-theme, palette entries do not.
components.when_not_to_use: Do not use support-* for decoration; they carry meaning and screen readers rely on it.
components.source: CoForge L1 primitive — derived from tokens, not from Carbon components

components.name: cf-spacing-scale
components.summary: The spacing steps. All margin, padding and gap come from here.

a11y.note: colour must never be the only carrier of meaning

components.when_to_use: Applies to margin, padding and gap alike.
components.when_not_to_use: Do not mix a spacing step with an arbitrary px nudge to 'make it line up'.
components.source: CoForge L1 primitive — derived from tokens, not from Carbon components

components.name: cf-rule

a11y.note: colour must never be the only carrier of meaning

components.when_to_use: Structural separation between sections.
components.when_not_to_use: Do not use a rule where whitespace would do — most rules are noise.
components.source: CoForge L1 primitive — derived from tokens, not from Carbon components

components.name: cf-table
components.summary: Tabular data with header, rows and optional zebra striping.

a11y.note: colour must never be the only carrier of meaning

components.when_to_use: Any data with two or more dimensions.
components.when_not_to_use: Do not use a table for layout. Do not use it for a single list — use a list.
components.source: CoForge L1 primitive — derived from tokens, not from Carbon components

components.name: cf-card
components.summary: A bounded surface grouping related content.

a11y.note: colour must never be the only carrier of meaning

components.when_to_use: Grouping content that belongs together and can be scanned as a unit.
components.when_not_to_use: Do not nest cards. If you need a card inside a card, the grouping is wrong.
components.source: CoForge L1 primitive — derived from tokens, not from Carbon components

components.name: cf-chart-palette
components.summary: The ordered categorical palette for data visualisation.

a11y.note: colour must never be the only carrier of meaning

components.when_to_use: Any chart. Series colours are ordered — use them in order.
components.when_not_to_use: Do not pick chart colours by eye, and never use semantic support-* colours for series.
components.source: CoForge L1 primitive — derived from tokens, not from Carbon components

components.name: cf-badge
components.summary: A small label carrying status or count.

a11y.note: colour must never be the only carrier of meaning

components.when_to_use: Short status. One or two words.
components.when_not_to_use: Do not use a badge for an action — it is not a button and is not focusable.
components.source: CoForge L1 primitive — derived from tokens, not from Carbon components
